page.overview:
Who is Shakuyaku?

Shakuyaku, most commonly known by her nickname Shakky, is the bartender of Shakky's Rip-off Bar on the Sabaody Archipelago (formerly on Hachinosu over 40 years ago). She lives with her husband Silvers Rayleigh.

Shakky formerly served in the Kuja Pirates as the First Mate of Gloriosa, her captain and the Kuja tribe's empress. She later succeeded Gloriosa as both the Kuja Pirates' captain as well as the Kuja's empress, before eventually being succeeded by Tritoma and Boa Hancock.

During her youth, Shakky was chased by the legendary Marine, Monkey D. Garp. After retiring as empress and captain, she opened her bar at Hachinosu, becoming famous in the world of pirates alongside her bar. While she was beloved by both the Rocks Pirates and Roger Pirates, she only had eyes for Silvers Rayleigh, the Roger Pirates' First Mate. 38 years ago, Shakky was kidnapped and made the ultimate prize for the winner of the Native Hunting Competition on God Valley, which served as one of the major triggers of the God Valley Incident. She was rescued by Rayleigh, which ultimately solidified their romantic relationship.

She is a minor ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Sabaody Archipelago Arc.
